cim: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
cim_eredeti: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
szoveg_eredeti: Chinese state-linked hackers used artificial intelligence, including the popular DeepSeek model, to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations around the world in just 11 days, according to the cybersecurity company CrowdStrike, in a campaign that illustrates how AI is allowing hackers to operate on a scale that previously required far more human effort.

prioritas.indok: Csak gépi pontozás (az AI-pontozás nem futott le); érdemes ránézni. Forrás-tapasztalat: -1.
